title.en: Carriage by Air (Singapore Currency Equivalents) Order

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Carriage by Air (Singapore Currency Equivalents) Order.

2. The amounts shown in the second column of the Schedule are specified as the amounts to be taken, for the purposes of Article 22 in the First and Second Schedules to the Act, as equivalent to the sums respectively expressed in francs in the first column of the Schedule.
